Chapter 8
Conclusion
8.1
Conclusion
The Intelligent Research Assistant has been successfully designed and developed as an
AI-powered research support system that combines modern Natural Language Process-
ing techniques with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). The system provides a
secure platform where users can upload research documents, organize them into personal
workspaces, and obtain accurate, context-aware answers based solely on the uploaded
content.
The project successfully integrates FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, SQLite, FAISS, Sentence
Transformers, Ollama, and JWT authentication into a unified application. The imple-
mented architecture ensures secure user authentication, efficient document management,
semantic document retrieval, and reliable answer generation with source citations.
The document processing pipeline extracts textual information from multiple doc-
ument formats, generates semantic embeddings, indexes them using FAISS, and re-
trieves the most relevant document chunks during question answering. By incorporating
Retrieval-Augmented Generation, the system significantly reduces hallucinations and im-
proves the accuracy of AI-generated responses.
One of the major strengths of the developed application is its modular architecture.
Each functional component—including authentication, workspace management, docu-
ment processing, embedding generation, vector storage, retrieval engine, prompt builder,
RAG engine, and citation engine—has been implemented independently. This modular
design improves maintainability, scalability, and future extensibility of the software.
Experimental evaluation demonstrates that the developed system performs efficiently
for document indexing, semantic search, and grounded response generation. The inte-
gration of citation support enables users to verify the authenticity of generated answers
directly from the original research documents, thereby increasing transparency and trust-
worthiness.
